notes.title: UpRooted Pre-Alpha Demo Patch 2/12/25: Quality Life, Polish, and Bug-Slaying
notes.notes:
Hey there!! It's been a minute, but we've been bug-slaying! 🪲⚔️
We've got a slew of updates and fixes:

Major fix
Fixed bug that caused Anaiah to freeze on mid-attack or scene change

General fixes and QoL Updates
Footsteps update: Finn has his own footstep sounds; Anaiah and Finn's personal footstep sounds are randomized
 The player character and following character have different volumes for their sound effects
 Improved Finn's melee timings
 Sped up Finn's dash, though we may have to revisit this further; Fixed dash horizontal distance
 Anaiah's root will not sprout off a cliff
 Red player bug mitigated
 Backdash works for both characters (This mechanic is not explained in the tutorial but if you find it... 👀)
 Fixed first level geometry
 Tuned run cycle animation speeds
 Fixed sounds duplicating on Finn's attacks
 Fixed occasional bug where the following character refused to go through doors
 Fixed bug where summoned wolves would spawn without a hitbox
 Fixed mana cost setting to zero

The next patch is focusing on controller support! In the meantime, we're still reworking our enemy and buddy AI. Additionally, we're looking to build for Mac, just wrestling some FMOD issues!

Some of these patches came from feedback, so please continue sharing your thoughts to help us grow! 

Thank you for the support!!
-💚 RootaBeta Games 🌱

notes.title: UpRooted Pre-Alpha Demo Patch 9/9/23: Finn Combat Update
notes.notes:
Hey there!! Back with another harvest of patches 🌱
This time we honed in on our paladin Finn!!
Finn's knockback should only happen on the third hit of his combo
His dash has improved (though there's a mild start delay that we're investigating)
Finn's death animations are in and working ☠️✨
We also covered a lot of general clean-up in this update!
Fixed Anaiah's bullet dead zones
Mana flowers will heal both characters again
Camera jitter while running has been removed!
Fixed weird sizing that was on certain wolves
Fixed our menus, quit the game or go to the start screen from anywhere in the game!

In the meantime, we're polishing our AI! That work overlaps with our enemy movement work, so it'll take a second for that to appear in the game. Our next patch should have more combat tweaks and polish ✨

Some of these patches came from feedback, so please continue sharing your thoughts to help us grow! 

Thank you for the support!!
-💚 RootaBeta Games 🌱

notes.title: UpRooted Pre-Alpha Demo Patch 4/19/23: Anaiah Movement Update
notes.notes:
Hey there!! It's been a second. We've been chipping away at assorted bugs, here's what RootaBeta Games has added and fixed:

-Updated survey link
-Fixed a bug where Anaiah would freeze while shooting
-Reworked Anaiah's movement with her attacks:

She resumes moving faster after shooting 
She resumes moving faster after sprouting a root
Her charged attack charges up faster
Her deployment for her stun attack is faster

-Touched up the wolves and wolf boss:

 They're now more responsive (temp fix, working on a movement rework for all enemies)
 They successfully howl and summon other wolves
 Fixed sizing issues

-Barriers no longer make a loud click at the start of a level
-Characters no longer stuck blue when switched while interacting with mana flowers
-Fixed tutorial text for Finn's lunge
-Sped up credits


All these fixes are just a small taste of what RootaBeta's been working on. While swatting at other bugs, we've also been pushing large-scale features like reworking our enemy navigation system, looking at our movement patterns, developing our dialogue system, and looking into more puzzles. Those features will take some time, but expect more small patches soon! I know we're eyeing some Finn changes for the next one.

Some of these patches came from feedback, so please continue sharing your thoughts to help us grow! 

Thank you for the support!!
-💚 RootaBeta Games 🌱
